conventions.coordinates: x,y in EXIF-transposed native pixels; bbox x0,y0,x1,y1 with x1,y1 exclusive

sobel.computed_on: full-image linear relative luminance Y before region masking (skimage.filters.sobel)
sobel.interior_rule: region eroded by 2 native px (scipy.ndimage.binary_erosion, iterations=2, border_value=0)
sobel.interpretation: mean gradient magnitude over valid interior; not outline width or readability

wavelet.label: native-pixel band energy (mean squared detail coefficient, squared linear-luminance units); not brushwork/material/beauty
wavelet.method: pywt.swt2 Haar level 1, norm=True, on full linear Y reflect-padded to even dims; coefficients cropped back to original extent; mask never zeroed before filtering

geometry.method: skimage.measure.regionprops on the 0/1 mask cast to int (one union label; no connected-component selection)
geometry.scope: whole-image (no user mask); describes the entire frame, not a subject, lighting or any semantic region

color.handling: no embedded ICC profile; sRGB assumed (assumption recorded)
color.reporting: encoded sRGB kept for palette/reporting; linearized only inside colour.sRGB_to_XYZ (single decode) and the EOTF in compositing

limitations: Descriptive statistics of the rendered image only; no aesthetic/style score, no inference of original scene, capture, lighting or materials.
Tone values are dimensionless, display-referred (D65); no nits, Kelvin, key/fill ratio or physical roughness is implied.
Region outputs describe the user-supplied mask union or the whole frame; not a detected subject or lighting region.
Edge/wavelet values are native-pixel descriptive energy, not outline width, brushwork, readability or quality.
native image < 128 px in a dimension; fine-detail/material conclusions unsupported (arithmetic still reported)

mask.scope: whole-image (no user mask); describes the entire frame, not a subject, lighting or any semantic region

palette.method: deterministic fixed quantization: 8 bins per encoded sRGB channel, bin=min(floor(c*8),7), bin_id=(r<<6)|(g<<3)|b; six most populous bins, ties by ascending bin_id; not kmeans

definitions.luminance_Y: relative luminance colour.sRGB_to_XYZ(encoded sRGB)[...,1], linear, single decode

value_color.scope: whole-image (no user mask); describes the entire frame, not a subject, lighting or any semantic region; rendered (composited) image, un-eroded mask union
value_color.units: dimensionless, display-referred D65; no nits, Kelvin, exposure, key/fill ratio or physical roughness is implied
